mapper.select: select * from major_field order by major_field_idx asc
select * from major_region order by major_region_idx asc
mapper.insert:
insert into company( company_idx, user_idx, company_num, phone, address, email, intro, photo, kakao_key ) values ( seq_company.nextval, #{user_idx}, #{company_num}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{email}, #{intro},
#{photo},
null,
null
)

insert into cert( cert_idx, user_idx, cert_name, get_date, cert_from, cert_type, cert_file, cert_status ) values ( seq_cert.nextval, #{user_idx}, #{cert_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, null, null, #{cert_type},
#{cert_file},
null,
#{cert_status} )

insert into company_region ( company_idx, major_region_idx, minor_region_idx, region_detail, branch_name, branch_tel)
values ( #{company_idx}, #{major_region_idx}, #{minor_region_idx}, #{region_detail}, #{branch_name}, #{branch_tel} )
mapper.select: select major_field_cd,b.* from major_field, (select minor_field_nm,major_field_idx,a.* from minor_field, (select * from company_provide where company_idx=#{idx}) a where minor_field.minor_field_idx=a.minor_field_idx) b where major_field.major_field_idx=b.major_field_idx

select major_region.region_nm,minor_region.district_nm,region_detail,branch_name,branch_tel from major_region,minor_region, (select * from company_region where company_idx=#{idx}) a where major_region.major_region_idx=a.major_region_idx and minor_region.minor_region_idx=a.minor_region_idx
select user_idx from users where login_id=#{login_id}
select company_idx from company where user_idx=#{idx}

select major_field.major_field_cd,c.* from major_field, (select minor_field.major_field_idx,minor_field.minor_field_nm,b.* from minor_field, (select company.user_idx,company.company_idx,company.phone,users.user_name, company.address,company.email,company.intro,decode(company.photo,null,'/img/profile/defaultProfile.jpg')as photo,minor_field_idx from users,company,company_provide, (select user_idx from membership where member_idx=#{member_idx}) a where users.user_idx=a.user_idx and company.user_idx=a.user_idx and company_provide.company_idx=company.company_idx) b where minor_field.minor_field_idx = b.minor_field_idx) c where major_field.major_field_idx = c.major_field_idx

select major_field.major_field_cd,major_region.region_nm,b.* from major_region,major_field, (select minor_field.major_field_idx, minor_field.minor_field_nm, minor_region.major_region_idx, minor_region.district_nm, a.* from minor_field,minor_region, (select * from class where provider_idx=#{idx} and end_date >= #{today} ) a where minor_field.minor_field_idx=a.minor_field_idx and minor_region.minor_region_idx=a.minor_region_idx) b where major_field.major_field_idx=b.major_field_idx and major_region.major_region_idx = b.major_region_idx
